title: New Zealand Dollar gains as US Dollar declines despite hawkish Fed tone
summary: NZD/USD inches higher after posting modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5680 during European hours on Thursday. The pair is appreciating as the New Zealand Dollar gains momentum, driven by growing expectations of further monetary tightening by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand.
